author: BMF7
content: Result: REQ-4 covenant engine (increment 2b) shipped. Deliverables: (1) covenant_eval.rs — a deterministic scalar (int/bool) executable-semantics evaluator (the in-Rust dual of exec_ref_value) with honest Unsupported/Trap errors; (2) covenant_engine.rs — analyze_covenant binds a witness to its preceding fn, EXECUTES inhabit witnesses against req (loud WitnessRefutesReq, never dropped), and rides thermite-tv's SplitMix64 Rng over the executable semantics (Q3 fixed-seed 50_000 default) producing CovenantRefuted + concrete counterexample; covenant_gate enforces covenant-before-burn structurally (closure-instrumented); (3) check.rs wires forge-routed fns through the gate AFTER the slag/boundary gate, before the L3 burn; (4) manifest.rs additive covenant_evidence cert block (oracle-included, Q-ORACLE), 7 v1 goldens byte-identical; (5) new conformance/covenant goldens (AC-8: planted-bug CovenantRefuted, no-witness refusal, correct L3); (6) REQ-S1-4 flipped partial->shipped, status view regenerated, req-registry --check clean. ACToR critic loop ran to CONVERGENCE: 5 divergences found+fixed+pinned (#298 stmt-if value discard, #299 assign-to-immutable, #300 witness width-check, #301 gate ordering vs slag, #302 integer bitwise-!). Gauntlet: clippy --all-targets -D warnings clean; fmt clean; 325 forge tests pass (the 7 engine::tests failures are the known Lean-spine environmental skip, NOT a regression); check_conformance 7/7 + covenant_conformance 3/3 with verus. 11 commits on the branch. NOTE: git push is blocked by policy for the agent — the branch is ready for a human to push + open the PR.
